items.title: Peter LaCaze Interview, 1972-01-27
items.q: See, and I liked his style of playing, see. In fact, I was more interested in him than I was in the balance of the band, see.

ctx.x: You were talking about how you listen to bands and that's how you get inspired to play music. Uh-huh. And who were the first bands you heard?

Well, the first band I heard was when I told you, the trumpet player in that band was Manuel Perez. Uh-huh. See, and I liked his style of playing, see. In fact, I was more interested in him than I was in the balance of the band, see. And with that band, they had a man playing trombone, a valve trombone or a tenor. I don't know what you call that instrument, a tenor or a valve trombone. Well, it had valves. Yeah. Is that a tenor or a trombone?
I call it a valve trombone.
